SIX COMMISSIONABLE CAPABILITIES

A question is rarely
just an economic question.

Scope a clear analytical service around the decision, evidence, delivery context and institution that need to move together.

F01 / COMMISSIONABLE

Costing, cost–benefit analysis and feasibility

Test the economic, financial, social and environmental case for an investment or programme.

Explore this capability↗
  • Economic and financial appraisal
  • Cost–benefit analysis, costing and financial models
  • Feasibility studies, assumptions and sensitivity analysis
F02 / COMMISSIONABLE

Investment, markets and financing

Translate market and programme evidence into options that institutions and investors can assess.

Explore this capability↗
  • Business, investment and financing plans
  • Market and financing studies
  • Resource mobilisation and financing models
F03 / COMMISSIONABLE

Policy, advocacy and institutions

Connect policy questions to the organisations, incentives and stakeholders that shape implementation.

Explore this capability↗
  • Policy analysis, advisory work and policy notes
  • Public–private coordination and business climate
  • Institutional analysis, capacity building and advocacy
F04 / COMMISSIONABLE

Programme leadership, implementation and M&E

Support programmes from design and budgeting through delivery, monitoring, evaluation and scale-up.

Explore this capability↗
  • Team assembly and multi-partner coordination
  • Operational planning, budgeting and delivery
  • M&E, MRM and MEL frameworks
F05 / COMMISSIONABLE

Research, surveys and impact evaluation

Build a fit-for-purpose evidence base through experimental research, measurement and mixed-methods inquiry.

Explore this capability↗
  • RCT and experimental research
  • Social impact, livelihoods and economic-development evaluation
  • Nationwide, baseline, midline and endline surveys
F06 / COMMISSIONABLE

Stakeholder convening and technical dialogue

Bring public institutions, researchers, businesses and development partners into a focused working conversation.

Explore this capability↗
  • Findings roundtables and dissemination sessions
  • Technical workshops and stakeholder dialogue
  • Facilitation that clarifies evidence, options and next steps
